properties.name: Miura
properties.description:
At Miura, we specialize in providing seamless global trade solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of businesses engaged in international commerce. From import and export management to comprehensive logistics, brokerage, and consulting services, Annex 24 software and management we ensure that our clients' operations run smoothly and efficiently across borders.

Our strength lies in our end-to-end services, where we handle everything from cross-border transportation and warehouse management to distribution and compliance. We leverage our expertise to manage specialized loads, including vacuum pneumatic trailers and chemical transportation, offering innovative and secure solutions that align with global standards such as CTPAT certification.

Since our founding, we've continually expanded our capabilities, providing advanced warehouse services such as picking, packing, and real-time inventory management, ensuring our clients have full visibility and control over their supply chain.

At Miura, our mission is to simplify global trade, empower our clients, and provide reliable, secure, and innovative logistics solutions that keep businesses moving forward.
